correctness.rationale: For every positive odd k the affine cobalancing recurrence b_(n+2)=6b_(n+1)-b_n+2, normalized by a=b/2, yields a_(n+k)-a_n=Q_k B_(n+(k-1)/2). The square-window difference is Q_k u_n v_n. The modular recurrence for u and v restricts gcd_n(u_n v_n) to a divisor of 7, with at most one 7; possible 7 requires 3|k. An independently checked exact telescoping coboundary 64a_(n+1)^2=Delta G+5 gives 64F_0 congruent 5k mod Q_k; Pell norm excludes 5|Q_k for odd k. For k odd divisible by 3, the 7-adic identity nu_7(Q_k)=1+nu_7(k) eliminates the potential extra factor in the full-window gcd. The result is gcd_n sum_i b_(n+i)^2=4 gcd(k,Q_k). Independent recurrence-based integer computation checked every odd k<=101 over hundreds of windows, but proof—not experiments—supports universal k and n.
